title: A Gate Before the Robot: The Safety Suite as a Release Condition, a Candidate That Looks Fine and Is Not, and the Fault the Gate Cannot See

artifact.note: a release gate that runs the safety suite on a candidate and refuses to deploy one that fails, joined to the pipeline of phase 20, with a candidate that works but is unsafe, one that is slow to give up, one that fails only on the robot, and a fleet with and without the gate
